transfer_threshold_status: research assumptions, not verified official minimum connection times
transfer_route_scope: Beijing candidate stations -> Xining -> Lhasa; exactly two separately identified train services
new_station_status: added to versioned draft based on actual returned Beijing grouping; not silently added to the original run
access_probe_scope: Endpoint feasibility probes only; no Macau access-time computation or full-window access route optimization
empty_result_policy: no direct records returned; not physical unreachability
same_service_policy: train_no + origin_service_date identifies a candidate same service; exclude from transfer pairs and save separately for direct-service verification
further_limits: No cross-station transfers; no tickets or physical transfer verification; not all-network shortest routes. Parent records and future-date records were collected at different times, with provenance retained.
